messages:
incident-bot: PagerDuty: HIGH — service=inference-queue | alert=queue_depth_exceeded | value=5200 | threshold=2000
incident-bot: link=https://pagerduty.example/INC12345 :rotating_light:

Eli: acked — I'm on it. seeing ~5.2k backlog on inference-requests. autoscaler isn't keeping up.

Maya: on it, checking autoscaler & provisioner logs now. ETA 2m.

Chen: rerouting low-priority tenants to dedicated pools to shave load. will post commands.

Eli: runbook step1: manual scale-up attempt. step2: check kube-provisioner errors / cloud quotas.

Maya: autoscaler shows repeated failures: "NodeProvisioner: capacity request failed: quotaExceeded". looks like project CPU quota hit.

Maya: ```
2026-03-15T14:08:02Z ERROR NodeProvisioner: createInstance failed: QuotaExceeded: You have exceeded CPU quota.
stack: /srv/provisioner/provision.go:164
```

Sam: confirmed in cloud console — CPU quota exhausted for project/redwood-prod-usw2. Manual increase required.

Eli: can we fall back to lighter model variants (quantized) to reduce node pressure? routing tradeoffs acceptable short-term.

Chen: starting gradual traffic-shift script to move ~20% -> dedicated-fallback pool. command: 
```
kubectl patch svc inference-api -p '{"spec":{"selector":{"tier":"dedicated"}}}'
```

ops-bot: executed: scale deployment/inference-worker from 80 -> 200 replicas (requested by Eli)

ops-bot: scaling failed: Insufficient capacity in region us-west-2 (cloud provider error)

Maya: also seeing a runaway batch job from internal-training, it saturated CPUs. I'm contacting compute-team to terminate the job.

Eli: PagerDuty escalation set: page platform lead (Sam) if unresolved in 10m @sam

Sam: I'm reachable, joining. Creating temporary quota increase request (may take 15-30m). Also will try spinning up a small eu-fallback pool.

Maya: mitigation checklist: 1) divert low-pri tenants, 2) reduce per-request batch_size to reduce memory/CPU, 3) enable KV cache warm-start on warm nodes. Applying batch override now.

Chen: applying batch_size override for heavy routes: 
```
POST /admin/config/override
{ "route":"*/embedding", "batch_size": 8 }
```

Eli: customer impact note: interactive API tail latency up by ~5-8s for some tenants, ~0.4% 503s reported. opening incident tickets for affected customers.

Sam: quota increase request submitted — status: PENDING. Portal shows ETA ~22m. Not fast enough for immediate relief.

Maya: temporary cross-region fallback: spinning up eu-west pool and routing 15% of traffic across regions to buy time.

ops-bot: applied cross-region route. traffic_shift=13% -> eu-west-fallback

Eli: monitoring: queue depth dropped to ~2800 after routing changes. request rate remains elevated but tail latencies trending down.

incident-bot: PagerDuty: INC12345 acked by Eli at 1764129998

oncall-shadow: I'll pick this up for night shift in ~45m. prepping handoff notes now.

Maya: creating incident postmortem stub and adding runbook links + customer-comm template.

Chen: handoff summary: 
- root cause: unexpected surge + long-running internal batch job exhausted cloud CPU quota, autoscaler unable to provision nodes
- impact: increased tail latency and small % of 503s for hosted API, customer tickets opened
- mitigations applied: tenant diversion to dedicated pools, batch_size override, cross-region fallback, manual quota request
- outstanding actions: confirm quota increase, add hard limits/alerts on batch jobs, tune autoscaler backoff and quota-aware retries

Eli: thanks team. tagging #incident-postmortem for follow-up.

Sam: will close PD after metrics stable for 30m and quota confirmed. I'll follow up with platform + finance on quota baseline.

incident-bot: PagerDuty: INC12345 resolved by Eli at 1764130500 :white_check_mark:
